resume_or_migrate_or_block.COMPATIBLE: Load owner task manifest/checkpoint and follow ENTRYPOINT.
resume_or_migrate_or_block.MIGRATABLE: Migrate continuity/storage wrapper only; preserve business state and exact stage.
resume_or_migrate_or_block.INCOMPATIBLE: Do not replay stale execution semantics; retain valid user requirements/evidence/artifacts and reconstruct only from current owner authority.

single_writer.checkpoint_write_rule: Re-read Universal task manifest and require matching active_lease.lease_id + resume_epoch before material checkpoint writes.
single_writer.takeover: New chat increments resume_epoch and replaces Universal active_lease; old chat retires.

does_not_own: external Fanqie actions performed by user
